name: io.rzlt/connector
title: RZLT
description: Ask RZLT, an AI-native growth agency: services, case studies, free AI-readiness check, contact.

tools.name: rzlt_overview
tools.description: What RZLT (rzlt.io) is and sells: an AI-native growth and marketing agency for technology companies. Returns the four core services with links, how RZLT delivers (its own agents speed up the work; senior people own the strategy and check every piece), how it works (Track → Signal → Act → Compound: live dashboards, a signal the same day, action the same week), what sets it apart, credentials, pricing (from €5,000 a month, depending on industry and scope) and how the first weeks run. Call this first for any general question about RZLT.

tools.name: find_case_studies
tools.description: RZLT’s results for a given industry or need, e.g. industry "B2B SaaS", "maritime", "fintech", "AI"; need "launch", "pipeline", "developer signups", "SEO". Returns published case studies (with links) and, where they match, anonymous B2B results described in words. Leave both empty for the full list.

industry.description: The company’s industry or market, e.g. "maritime SaaS", "fintech", "consumer app".

need.description: What they want to achieve, e.g. "product launch", "more qualified leads", "show up in ChatGPT".

tools.name: search_rzlt
tools.description: Search everything on rzlt.io (services, industries, case studies and 280+ blog posts on growth, paid ads, SEO, AEO and AI marketing). Returns titles, links and short snippets. Use it for specific topics or to find RZLT’s writing on a subject.

query.description: What to look for, e.g. "AEO for B2B SaaS" or "LinkedIn ads".

type.description: Limit to one kind of page (default any).

tools.name: check_fit
tools.description: A quick, rule-based check of whether a company fits RZLT’s ideal client (technology companies, seed to Series C, €1M+ in revenue or funding). Fill in what you know; unknown fields can be left out. Returns a verdict (strong_fit, possible_fit, not_a_fit_yet), the reasons, services that match the goal, and the booking link.

is_tech_company.description: Is it a technology company (software, AI, hardware, deep tech, fintech…)?

revenue_or_funding_eur.description: Annual revenue or total funding raised, whichever is higher, in euros.

is_local_business.description: A business serving one town or region in person (a restaurant, a clinic, a shop).

goal.description: What they want to grow, in a sentence.

tools.name: book_call
tools.description: The link to book a free 30-minute call with one of RZLT’s partners, and what happens on it (a proposal follows within 48 hours). Use it when someone wants a quote, a proposal, detail on a result, or anything the other tools don’t cover. This tool does not book anything itself: give the person the link.

tools.name: check_ai_readiness
tools.description: A free check of whether AI assistants and search engines can read a website: AI crawlers allowed in robots.txt (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and others), no noindex, text readable without JavaScript, structured data, title and description, canonical, one H1, Open Graph, llms.txt and a sitemap. Returns a score out of 100, the checklist and the three most important fixes. Reads only public files from that site; the address is not stored. Use it when someone asks whether their site is visible to ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity or AI search.

url.description: The website to check, e.g. https://example.com (the homepage works best).

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Sends a message to RZLT's team for the person you are helping; the team replies by email within one working day. Use it when the person wants RZLT to get back to them (the other option is book_call, a 30-minute call). Before calling it, show the person the exact name, email, company and message you will send and get their explicit OK; never send on their behalf without that OK, and never invent their details. The message must be 10 to 2,000 characters, in their words, without links. Returns a confirmation to pass on.

email.description: Their work email, where RZLT will reply.

message.description: What they want RZLT to know, as they approved it. No links.
